simple.summary: חָגוֹר (châgôwr) means belted First listed occurrence: Ezek 23 15.

definitions.full: H2289. chagor [ חָגוֺר ] adjective girt, girded , only plural construct; אֵזוֺר חֲגוֺרֵי Ezek 23:15 girded with a waist-cloth .
